north_star: Make private local knowledge as fast and dependable to query as a calculator, without turning retrieval into an unbounded agent.
wedge: A read-only Python CLI and Raycast Script Command that return bounded, source-cited evidence from a fresh local JSONL Vault index.
target_user: People who keep a local JSONL-first knowledge vault and need immediate answers from Raycast or a terminal.
core_promise: Turn a natural-language vault query into inspectable evidence in seconds while preserving local ownership and safe abstention.
product_principles: Retrieval owns evidence; optional models may summarize but never invent or expand authority.
Fast failure is better than a plausible answer from stale or missing evidence.
Public code and tests use only synthetic data; private vault content never enters Git.
non_goals: Running a general-purpose agent over the vault.
Replacing the canonical JSONL Vault writer, indexer, or validation contract.
Optimizing only for entity or contact questions.
success_metrics: A fresh-index query returns bounded cited evidence with p95 latency below one second on the target Mac.
Missing and ambiguous questions abstain instead of returning unrelated facts.
A fresh clone can install, validate, test, and add the Raycast command from documented steps.
